summary: Capote is a 2005 biographical film about Truman Capote that follows his experiences while writing the non-fiction book In Cold Blood. Philip Seymour Hoffman won several awards, including the Academy Award for Best Actor, for his acclaimed portrayal of the title character. The film was directed by Bennett Miller, based on Gerald Clarke's biography Capote, and filmed mostly in Manitoba in autumn 2004 before its release on September 30, 2005.
one_line: A 2005 biographical film by Bennett Miller about Truman Capote's writing of In Cold Blood, with Philip Seymour Hoffman's Oscar-winning lead performance.
key_facts: Capote is a 2005 biographical film about Truman Capote.
The film follows the events during the writing of Truman Capote's non-fiction book In Cold Blood.
Philip Seymour Hoffman won several awards, including the Academy Award for Best Actor, for his critically acclaimed portrayal of the title character.
The film was based on Gerald Clarke's biography Capote.
The film was directed by Bennett Miller.
The film was filmed mostly in Manitoba in the autumn of 2004.
The release date was chosen to coincide with Truman Capote's birthday.
